answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes an oasis bet on surviving 57 epochs of grading, and every shale settlement recomputes the vault schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 57 epochs rather than arriving at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
